home.translate_card: Translate SRT and VTT files into dozens of languages.
home.how_step1: Drop in a media or subtitle file.
home.apps_text: The web app is a light version of the desktop app: fewer features, but it handles most jobs smoothly right in your browser. The desktop app isn't bound by browser limits and can also process very large files.
home.faq_a1: Media files are transcribed; subtitle files like SRT and VTT are translated. Everything else is handled for you automatically.

transcribe.title: AI Transcription — Video & Audio to Subtitles
transcribe.meta_description: Automatically generate subtitles from video and audio files with AI. Fast, accurate, right in your browser.
transcribe.lead: Upload a video or audio file and get accurate subtitles in minutes. Your file is converted locally — only the audio track is uploaded.
transcribe.faq_a1: Media is converted to a mono MP3 in your browser; only that audio track is uploaded for transcription.
transcribe.faq_a2: Common video and audio formats are supported. You always receive SRT or VTT subtitles.
transcribe.faq_q3: What if the transcription is in the wrong language?
transcribe.faq_a3: The selected language must match the spoken language of your file. Transcription and translation are separate steps — transcribe first, then translate the result into any language.
faq.title: FAQ — AI Subtitle Transcription & Translation
faq.meta_description: Frequently asked questions about AI subtitle transcription, translation, credits, refunds and file formats at AI.OpenSubtitles.com.
faq.lead: Answers about transcription, translation, credits and refunds.
faq.refund_q: A job failed or I'm not happy with the result — do I get my credits back?
faq.refund_a: Failed jobs are never charged: an automatic quality check validates every transcription and translation. If you are unhappy with a result, contact us anytime and we will refund your credits.
faq.credits_a: Pay as you go: buy credits and use them for any AI service. Credits never expire and you only pay for what you actually use.
translate.title: AI Subtitle Translation — SRT & VTT
translate.meta_description: Translate subtitle files into dozens of languages with AI. Preserve timing, keep the meaning, done in your browser.
translate.lead: Upload an SRT or VTT file, pick a target language, and let AI translate it while keeping your timing intact.
translate.faq_a1: SRT and VTT are the standard output formats; more input formats are supported.
translate.faq_a2: Possibly — it depends on the language pair and the model. Timestamps are kept when possible, but if the target language needs shorter captions (e.g. Japanese), captions may be split, which changes the timings.
translate.faq_q3: Why does my translation fail or produce strange characters?
translate.faq_a3: Almost always an incorrect character encoding. Save subtitle files as UTF-8 without BOM before uploading — files in legacy encodings (e.g. Windows-1252) may fail or produce broken characters.

faq.quality_q: What happens if a translation fails the quality check?
faq.quality_a: Every translation is checked automatically against the original subtitle file: completeness, timing, untranslated passages, wrong alphabets and reading speed. If a translation fails, you still receive the file — and the credits are refunded automatically, no support ticket needed. The check applies to translations only; transcription jobs are not affected.
translate.quality_note: Every translation is checked automatically before delivery — over 99% pass the check. If one doesn’t, you still receive it, free of charge.
pricing.quality_note: Only translations that pass the automatic quality check are charged — failed translations are delivered anyway and refunded automatically.
